name: Cold Shock
short: Your left click: instant water hit at 20 m that gives back 100 MP. Opens the Vacuum Blast / Earth Tremor chain.
desc: Deals water damage to a target within 20 m and restores 100 MP.

name: Vacuum Blast
short: Second hit of the left-click chain, option 1 of 2: wind damage and the same 100 MP back.
desc: Deals wind damage to a target within 20 m and restores 100 MP.

name: Earth Tremor
short: The other second hit of the left-click chain, and the biggest mana return in the kit: 150 MP.
desc: Deals earth damage to a target within 20 m and restores 150 MP.

name: Flame Cremation
short: Your right click: 4-target fire AoE filler. 3 groggy gauge.
desc: Deals fire damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away. Groggy gauge damage: 3.

name: Summon: Fire Spirit
short: The damage spirit: charges in and AoEs, then re-uses its skill with a 15% chance per landed attack.
desc: Summons the Fire spirit. It charges a target within 20 m and uses a skill dealing fire damage to up to 4 enemies within 5 m, then keeps fighting with basic attacks and re-uses its skill with a 15% chance per landed attack. Each skill level raises its attack and defence by 2%. Groggy gauge damage: 7. Spirit skill recast: 3 s.

name: Summon: Water Spirit
short: The mana spirit: single-target water damage, and every proc gives you 20 MP back.
desc: Summons the Water spirit. It uses a skill dealing water damage to a target within 20 m, then keeps fighting with basic attacks and, with a 15% chance per landed attack, re-uses its skill and restores 20 MP to you. Each skill level raises its attack and critical by 2%. Groggy gauge damage: 7. Spirit skill recast: 3 s.

name: Joint Strike: Curse
short: Joint attack with your spirit. Applies Curse: a 5 s DoT that also cuts the target's damage against you by 10%.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and applies Curse. Curse: damage every second for 5 s, and the target deals 10% less damage to you. Joint strike with your spirit: Fire, area damage; Water, damage; Earth, damage and -10% status resistance; Wind, area damage and a DoT; Ancient, area damage. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Continuous Barrage
short: Only fires against a groggy target: free damage during the groggy window.
desc: Deals damage to a target in a groggy state within 20 m.

name: Summon: Earth Spirit
short: The tank spirit: builds threat and, against players, taunts for 2 s with a 50% chance.
desc: Summons the Earth spirit. It uses a skill dealing earth damage to a target within 20 m and building threat; against a player, a 50% chance of a 2 s taunt. It then keeps fighting with basic attacks and, with a 10% chance per landed attack, re-uses its skill. Each skill level raises its defence and health by 2%. Groggy gauge damage: 7. Spirit skill recast: 3 s.

name: Domination
short: Lights up for a moment every time a spirit casts. 4-target AoE, -40% movement speed for 3 s, and 100 MP back.
desc: A skill that activates for a short time every time a spirit uses its skill. Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and slows them 40% for 3 s. Restores 100 MP. Groggy gauge damage: 5.

name: Summon: Wind Spirit
short: The sustain spirit: wind AoE that heals you 1.5% of max HP on every proc.
desc: Summons the Wind spirit. It uses a skill dealing wind damage to up to 4 enemies within 5 m around a target 20 m away and healing you. It then keeps fighting with basic attacks and, with a 10% chance per landed attack, re-uses its skill and heals you 1.5% of max health. Each skill level raises its accuracy and critical by 2%. Groggy gauge damage: 7.

name: Soul's Scream
short: 70% chance of a 5 s fear (100% on NPCs): your main hard control at range.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and, with a 70% chance, fears it for 5 s. Against NPCs the fear lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 15.

name: Elemental Fusion
short: Spends the 4-element state your spirits build up. Usable only at 4 stacks, and it consumes them all.
desc: Every time a spirit uses a skill you gain an element. At 4 stacks you enter the 4-element state and can use Elemental Fusion; it can only be used in that state and consumes the 4 elements instantly. Deals damage to a target within 20 m. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Shock Release
short: Your only real defensive: cleanses stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear, then 5 s of status immunity.
desc: Removes your stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear states and puts you in Tenacity for 5 s. Tenacity: immunity to status ailments.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 1 min to 41 s.

name: Curse of Despair
short: Shock Release's chain: a 75% chance of fear and root together for 5 s, right after you break a control.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and, with a 75% chance, applies fear and root for 5 s. Against NPCs both land 100% of the time.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 2 min to 1 min 22 s.

name: Elemental Strike
short: +1% attack for you and +1% for your spirit. The rank-20 curve is what makes it the first passive to max.
desc: Your attack increases by 1% and your spirit's attack by 1%.
rank20: +20% attack for you and +20% for your spirit.

name: Spirit Protection
short: +1.5% defence for you and +1.5% for your spirit.
desc: Your defence increases by 1.5% and your spirit's defence by 1.5%.
rank20: +30% defence for you and +30% for your spirit.

name: Spirit Descent
short: For 10 s after a summon, every landed attack has a 50% chance of extra damage. The Ancient Spirit stretches it to 30 s.
desc: For 10 s after summoning a spirit, each of your landed attacks has a 50% chance to deal extra damage. When you summon the Ancient Spirit, Spirit Descent lasts 30 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Erosion
short: +100 critical, and a 50% chance of extra damage on every critical hit.
desc: Your critical increases by 100 and on a critical hit you have a 50% chance to deal extra damage.

name: Spirit Regeneration
short: 11% chance per hit to cut summon cooldowns by 1 s, and an automatic 12% heal on a spirit below half health.
desc: On a landed attack, 11% chance to cut the recast limit of your summon skills by 1 s. When a summoned spirit is at 50% health or below, it recovers 12% of its maximum health. Internal cooldowns: 1 s for the recast cut, 30 s for the spirit heal.
rank20: 30% chance on hit, and the spirit heal goes to 50% of max health.

name: Mental Focus
short: +11% mental-type accuracy and +0.3% Smite: the stat that makes your fears and seals actually land.
desc: Your mental-type accuracy increases by 11% and your Smite by 0.3%.

name: Chain Backflow
short: Extra damage 50% of the time against targets already taking damage over time.
desc: Each time you land an attack on a target that is taking damage over time, you have a 50% chance to deal extra damage.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Spirit Communion
short: +100 accuracy, and a 10% chance per landed attack to heal both you and your spirit.
desc: Your accuracy increases by 100 and each landed attack has a 10% chance to restore health to you and your spirit.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no heal figure.

name: Contract of Revival
short: +17% status resistance, stacking while you are controlled, plus an automatic 35% heal below 10% HP.
desc: Your status resistance increases by 17% and, when hit while stunned, knocked down, air-bound, frozen or feared, it increases by a further 10% for 5 s, stacking 10 times. At 10% health or below you instantly recover 35% of max health. Internal cooldowns: 1 min heal, 1 s resistance.

name: Elemental Cohesion
short: Every spirit skill hit stacks +1.1% critical damage amplification for you and your spirit, up to 5 stacks.
desc: Each time one of your skill attacks lands, your and your spirit's critical damage amplification increases by 1.1% for 10 s, stacking up to 5 times. Internal cooldown: 1 s per spirit.

name: Joint Strike: Assault
short: Stigma. Joint attack with your spirit and the biggest groggy contribution in the kit: 50.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m. Joint strike with your spirit: Fire, area damage; Water, damage; Earth, damage; Wind, area damage; Ancient, area damage. Groggy gauge damage: 50.

name: Gale
short: Stigma. 10 s of +20% PvE / +10% PvP damage and tolerance for you and your spirits, plus 185-203 HP per second.
desc: For 10 s, you and your summoned spirits gain +20% PvE and +10% PvP damage amplification, +20% PvE and +10% PvP damage tolerance, and you recover 185 to 203 health per second. Not affected by cooldown-increasing effects.
rank20: The heal goes from 185-203 to 625-687 HP per second.

name: Blessing of Flame
short: Stigma. For 10 s, every attack has a 50% chance of extra damage. Internal cooldown 1 s.
desc: For 10 s, each of your attacks has a 50% chance to deal extra damage to the enemy. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: The window goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Summon: Ancient Spirit
short: Stigma. A 30 s spirit whose every cast grants a 4-element charge, and it re-casts after 7 basic attacks.
desc: Summons the Ancient Spirit for 30 s; each time it uses its skill you gain a 4-element charge. Its skill damages up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away, then it keeps fighting with basic attacks and re-casts after 7 of them. Each skill level raises its attack, defence, accuracy and critical by 2%. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Joint Strike: Corrosion
short: Stigma. 20 s of Corrosion: +10% damage taken from spirits plus a DoT, and a different control per spirit.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and applies Corrosion for 20 s. Corrosion: +10% damage taken from spirits, plus damage every second. Joint strike: Fire, area damage and knockdown; Water, damage and slow; Earth, damage and seal; Wind, area damage and stun; Ancient, area damage and knockdown. Groggy: 10.

name: Kaisinel's Authority
short: Stigma. +20% status-ailment accuracy and +20% status resistance for 10 s: the window you land your fears in.
desc: For 10 s, your status-ailment accuracy increases by 20% and your status-ailment resistance by 20%.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Absorption
short: Stigma. Burns 300 of the target's MP and gives you 10% HP and 300 MP back: your resource steal.
desc: Deals damage and 300 MP damage to a target within 20 m. You absorb 10% of your health and restore 300 MP.

name: Scream of Fear
short: Stigma. AoE version of the fear: 50% chance on up to 4 enemies for 5 s (100% on NPCs).
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and, with a 50% chance, fears them for 5 s. Against NPCs the fear lands 100% of the time.

name: Cursed Cloud
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE that leaves a 10 s damage-over-time: it feeds the Chain Backflow passive.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away. They then take damage every second for 10 s. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Spell Steal
short: Stigma. Strips up to 2 buffs from 4 enemies and hits harder for each one removed.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and removes up to 2 buffs. Extra damage in proportion to the number of buffs removed. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Spell Block
short: Stigma. 75% chance to seal the target for 5 s: it locks the target's skills.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and, with a 75% chance, seals it for 5 s. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Fear
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 30% fear that also gives you up to +20% defence, scaling with how many you hit.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m around a target 20 m away and, with a 30% chance, fears them for 5 s. Against NPCs the fear lands 100% of the time. Your defence increases by up to 20% in proportion to the number of targets hit.

name: Command: Proxy
short: Stigma. For 5 s your spirit eats half the damage aimed at you, as long as it stays within 25 m.
desc: For 5 s, your spirit's PvE damage tolerance increases by 20% and its PvP by 10%, and each time you are attacked 50% of the damage goes to you and 50% to the spirit. It applies to the summoned spirit with the most health, the nearest on a tie, and only shares damage while the spirit is within 25 m.
rank20: The split reads 31% and 31% instead of 50% and 50%.
